Nehapaiyaꞌmonanafa lapakaefeꞌmo, ala tisa nene, huꞌa lapaki aesaya agufa kavatapimo ohaneꞌniye. Ala tisa netapimo magoke vekatapimo maiꞌnigetapaeꞌmo lapakaemo magoke aiyaya konaga vayaꞌmo maiꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmae.

Kava netapimo magoke vekamo Kalaisiꞌa maiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo lapakaefeꞌmo, kava vayatimogitapae, huꞌa lapaki aesaya gemo ohaneꞌniye.
